contexts: laboratory information system hold and comment
reading: An early repeat request is the product of practice routines (booked reviews, pharmacist requesting, locum cover) meeting a laboratory that runs every request. The hold rule moves the decision to the moment of request and adds an override, so its feasibility depends on how quickly clinicians can override for real exceptions and on whether they accept the comment. Safety depends on the exception categories. Practice variation means the pilot must include both high-repeat and typical practices.

nodes.label: Override for accepted exceptions
nodes.detail: Pregnancy, new diagnosis, transfusion, treatment change (claim c5).

nodes.label: Override time and reasons
nodes.detail: About 11 percent overridden, median 1 day elsewhere (claim c3).

nodes.label: Delayed important decision
nodes.detail: Safety review of held requests (claim c2).

nodes.label: Network clinical governance committee
nodes.detail: Decision deferred pending a safety review.

summary: Map shows the rule's feasibility resting on overrides, safety and acceptance, with network approval as a condition.
